notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Patch notes for this period:

•	How to play Tab update

•	Remade some of the Villain caught stuff, using the character move component and disable 
movement when player is caught.

•	removed some stuff that didn't work as it should, or primary didn't work at all on AI and could also 
be a reason to hang ups.

•	Started to implement some of the player controller logic to the main menu controller

•	Controller update

•	UI Update for Tricks and pickups

•	Tricks combo added

•	Optimized map

Thank you all for still being with us! Feel free to chat with us on the forms.

Remember this is a game built by the community so if there's anything you find or want to see, and we can make it happen we got you!

notes.title: DreamHack fans request update!
notes.content:
3D Dojo Studios attended the October DreamHack in ATL GA, where we showcased our upcoming PC game called the "DA PAPER BOY" and we was amazed at how many of the folks there became fans of our game. In the mist of everyone enjoying the game so many of y'all made requests of things you would like to see in the game, and as I stated many times this is a community game made by the community. By that being said we have worked very hard and achieved everything that was requested at DreamHack!  

In this video we address everything that was asked for including adding a controller function and more! 

-Patch Notes-
-You can now shoot the followers with a cost of points
-Achievements enabled
-Controller enabled
-Steam Leaderboard enabled
-Update accuracy on paper, higher velocity and lower gravity 
-Update demo assets
-Update dizzy assets 
-Make skater and bob stunnable with a cost of 2000
-Achievements works to get bike unlocked 
-Loose dog is also stunnable with a loss of 2000 points 
-Cursor size fixed
-Update you can now save game menu
